# Eve Air Mobility and FlyBIS Sign Binding Agreement for Up to 12 eVTOLs in Southern Brazil


November 04, 2026 8:00 AM EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_3ba00c40e6eae0381bf86d339ccf16a5/eveairmobility/news/2026-11-04_Eve_Air_Mobility_and_FlyBIS_Sign_Binding_121.pdf)


*Agreement includes 2 firm orders and purchase rights for 10 additional aircraft.*


**MELBOURNE, Fla., Nov. 4, 2026 —** Eve Air Mobility (NYSE: EVEX; B3: EVEB31) **** and FlyBIS Aviation Limited (“FlyBIS”) today announced the signing of a binding agreement for up to 12 electric Vertical Take-Off and Landing (eVTOL) aircraft. The agreement comprises two firm orders and purchase rights for 10 additional units.


The agreement builds on the Letter of Intent the companies announced in 2022 and advances their collaboration to establish electric air mobility operations in Brazil. FlyBIS plans to deploy Eve’s eVTOL in Southern Brazil, initially connecting destinations in Santa Catarina and Rio Grande do Sul.


Potential routes include connections in cities such as Navegantes, Balneário Camboriú and Florianópolis along Santa Catarina’s coastline, as well as services in tourism destinations in Rio Grande do Sul’s mountain region, including Gramado and Bento Gonçalves.


“This binding agreement is an important step in our relationship with FlyBIS and demonstrates how our customers are progressing from early market development to concrete fleet commitments,” said Johann Bordais, Chief Executive Officer of Eve. “Southern Brazil harbors high demand for urban air mobility connections as it combines strong tourism and business activity. Together with FlyBIS, we will continue working to prepare the ecosystem for safe, efficient and sustainable eVTOL operations in the region.”


Eve and FlyBIS will continue collaborating on the requirements to support entry into service, including network planning, operational readiness, infrastructure and the integration of eVTOL services into the broader transportation ecosystem.


“Signing this binding agreement represents a significant milestone for FlyBIS and moves us closer to introducing a new form of regional and urban connectivity in Southern Brazil,” said Gustavo Zanettini, co-founder and Chief Executive Officer of FlyBIS. “Eve’s integrated approach, combining the aircraft with services and operational support, provides a strong foundation as we prepare for future operations. We look forward to working together to connect important destinations more efficiently while delivering a safe and high-quality experience for our customers.”


The agreement comes as Eve continues to advance the development of its eVTOL and the broader ecosystem required to support commercial operations. Following its first flight, Eve’s full-scale engineering prototype has completed more than 70 flights, including the hover and low-speed phases of its flight-test campaign. The company is now progressively expanding the aircraft’s flight envelope through transition-flight testing, including the in-flight activation of its rear pusher propulsion system as it advances toward wing-borne flight.


In September 2026, Brazil’s Ministry of Ports and Airports brought together aviation authorities, government representatives and Eve to discuss certification, vertiport infrastructure, energy supply, operational safety, telecommunications and airspace integration.


Brazil represents a premier market for urban air mobility, supported by government and certification authorities, a rapidly maturing ecosystem and strong passenger demand in cities where infrastructure has not kept pace with growth. These conditions make Brazil one of Eve’s most important markets and position the country to be among the first to scale commercially following certification, with two operators already committed to deploying Eve’s eVTOL and several others showing strong interest.

##


**About Eve Air Mobility**


Eve Air Mobility is dedicated to accelerating the Urban Air Mobility (UAM) ecosystem. Benefiting from a start-up mindset, backed by Embraer’s 57-year history of aerospace expertise, and with a singular focus, Eve is taking a holistic approach to progressing the UAM ecosystem, with an advanced eVTOL project, comprehensive global services and support network and a unique air traffic management solution. Eve is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (EVEX) and the São Paulo Stock Exchange (EVEB31), where its shares of common stock and Brazilian Depository Receipts are traded. For more information, please visit[www.eveairmobility.com](http://www.eveairmobility.com/) .


**About FlyBIS**


FlyBIS is an Advanced Air Mobility startup focused on developing a more sustainable and efficient approach to air transportation in Southern Brazil and Latin America.


Backed by decades of aviation experience and partnering with Eve Air Mobility, FlyBIS is building the operational and commercial foundation for the emerging AAM market in Southern Brazil. Our strategy goes beyond aircraft operations, integrating mobility services, technology, and strategic partnerships into a scalable AAM platform.


To support its long-term vision, FlyBIS is launching a new strategic fundraising round to support fleet acquisition, advance strategic partnerships, and expand the FlyBIS network. FlyBIS. Your Time, Your Future!


For more information, visit:[www.flybis.com](http://www.flybis.com/) .
